# Knowhow

> Case studies with screens and videos: an AI-native CRM, B2B onboarding, a Slack teammate for analytics, agentic seller experiences, an e-commerce decision harness, travel agents and more. Share your specific need and reach the builder.

Knowhow answers one question: “Has anybody already built this?” Each project page explains the question, the approach, the tradeoff and the lesson, with every screen and video. To reach the builder, share your specific need at aditya@decisionos.me.

## Projects

- [Voice-first e-commerce shopping](https://knowhow.build/projects/voice-commerce/): Has anybody already built a shop you can just talk to? Search, ask about products and shortlist them in one continuous voice conversation.
- [Agents in investment management](https://knowhow.build/projects/investment-agents/): Has anybody already built agents built into an online investment platform? A video walkthrough of an investment platform with agents at its core.
- [Voice-based analytics: an analyst on the call](https://knowhow.build/projects/voice-analytics/): Has anybody already built an analyst that answers while you’re still on the call? Ask a question out loud and the evidence appears while the conversation is still happening.
- [Proactive analytics: insights without asking](https://knowhow.build/projects/proactive-analytics/): Has anybody already built analytics that tell you what changed before you ask? Benchmarks, data-hygiene checks and a daily brief instead of another dashboard.
- [Seller onboarding experience](https://knowhow.build/projects/seller-onboarding/): Has anybody already built a conversational-based onboarding experience? Getting a new marketplace seller to their first sale: one step at a time, with help exactly where they get stuck.
- [The changing face of CRM](https://knowhow.build/projects/crm-customer-harness/): Has anybody already built a CRM for tracking leads on an e-commerce system? What a CRM competes on once anyone can rebuild the workflow in a weekend.
- [A Slack teammate for product and analytics teams](https://knowhow.build/projects/slack-teammate/): Has anybody already built a Slack teammate that learns from the whole team? Turning each expert’s personal skills into a shared assistant everyone can use.
- [Delightful seller experiences in an agentic world](https://knowhow.build/projects/agentic-seller-experiences/): Has anybody already built an agent that runs the seller side of a marketplace? A three-part series on agents for marketplace sellers — cohorts, workflows and why chat isn’t the strategy.
- [Software that consults: context as the new moat](https://knowhow.build/projects/software-that-consults/): Has anybody already built software that consults instead of just executing? When software is cheap to build, depth of context, owning the workflow and delivering outcomes become the moat.
- [AI product teardown: Asana as an OS for human–agent teams](https://knowhow.build/projects/asana-agentic-teardown/): Has anybody already built an AI-native work manager for humans and agents? Concepts for how Asana could look if it were built today, with fictional project data.
- [Todoist as a true non-technical agent](https://knowhow.build/projects/todoist-agent/): Has anybody already built a to-do app that becomes an agent for everyday people? Ideas for how Todoist could lead in an agent-first world without overwhelming its users.
- [Agentic customer experiences for travel](https://knowhow.build/projects/travel-agentic-cx/): Has anybody already built an agent that plans the whole trip, not just the booking? Earning the next booking by making this trip easier.
- [The forks in the road for assistants](https://knowhow.build/projects/assistant-forks-hermes/): Has anybody already built a personal assistant that keeps up across mobile and desktop? Where personal agents are heading, illustrated with Hermes prototypes.
- [Animated shorts on building](https://knowhow.build/projects/animated-shorts/): Has anybody already built short animations that make an idea stick? A series of short animations about ideas, incubation and luck.
